column_description: Full name of the user. may be NULL.
Email address of the user. may be NULL.
Role of the user (e.g., animator, modeler, admin). always exactly one of 'animator', 'modeler', 'admin'. may be NULL.
Hashed password for the user. may be NULL.
Date and time the user account was created. may be NULL.
Date and time the user account was last updated. may be NULL.
Flag to indicate if the user account is active. may be NULL.
Date and time of the user's last login. may be NULL.
